> Bool

> 42
() : ()
> x : Int
> -- TYPE MISMATCH ---------------------------------------- <repl>

(/) needs:

    Float

but this operand is:

    Int

1| x / 2
   ^

(/) works only on `Float`, and an `Int` does not convert by itself. Convert with
`Basics.fromInt`, or divide integers with `Basics.quotientBy`.
> 1
x : ()
> -2 : Num a => a
> False : Bool
> True : Bool
> -- TYPE MISMATCH ---------------------------------------- <repl>

Both sides of (&&) must be a Bool, but this one is:

    String

1| "a" && True
   ^^^
> | | | "b" : String
